question: Materialize the frozen multiscale roster and layer-18 local/semantic scores for the untouched seventh-family axis-completion vacancy confirmation.

predecessor.single_change: Move the fixed at-most-three vacancy-only axis-completion proposal set to wholly new door 3 without changing any contributor, score, vote, completion mode or set bound.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses the target reference; normalized foreground patches from DINOv2 ViT-L/14 zero-based block 18 supply query-directed local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches.
final_confirmation_hypotheses: layer-18 local minus 0.05 times distance to the nearest of the three reference target log-area fractions
best semantic/local-fusion candidate constrained to the majority winning target reference across all three query observations
only if exact deduplication leaves a vacancy below three, append one reference-scale horizontal/vertical axis completion without removing an original candidate

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; final vacancy-set coverage is evaluated on deduplicated proposal or axis-completion boxes.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after reference voting, all preserved contributors, deduplication, vacancy decision and optional axis completion are complete.

literature_motivation.use: Adaptive spatial completion from initial near-boundary detections.

literature_motivation.source: Aspect Ratio and Context Aware Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks for Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Bounded aspect-ratio and context configurations for localization.

forbidden_after_freeze: change rows, windows, proposals, features, any preserved contributor, 0.05 nearest-reference-scale penalty, majority-reference vote, deterministic tie order, deduplication, vacancy condition, axis modes, set size three or IoU gate
use sibling, controls or truth in hypothesis generation
claim_boundary: This intermediate only materializes the frozen candidate roster and scores; it is not final authority, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty or downstream navigation evidence.
